Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with ongoing right knee
pain and swelling. Over the course of 27 visits, care consisted of physical therapy,
anti-inflammatory medication, and home exercise instruction, progressing in a typical
pattern for this type of soft tissue injury. Visit frequency was highest early in
treatment and tapered as the patient's pain decreased and range of motion improved.
Examination revealed localized tenderness and a positive effusion sign on the affected
side, findings consistent with the mechanism of injury, while certain ligament
stability tests were within normal limits. The patient reprots no prior injury or
treatment involving this knee. Billed services align with the documented care plan,
with no duplicated or repeated charges identified on review. Current status shows
substantial improvement, with the patient transitioned to self-directed exercise and
discharged from active care pending any recurrence of symptoms.
